requirements: All v2 semantic requirements remain after mapping the current partner schema.
The authoritative external schema history is state/schema-history.json.
schema.idField, schema.valueField, and schema.statusField identify the current partner field names.
Only records whose status is in schema.activeStatuses are eligible.
Map the partner id/value fields into the stable { id, value } output.
If schema.valueCoercion is number_to_string, numeric values must be returned as strings.
state/external-signal.json is diagnostic context describing the current partner cutover.
The result remains deterministic and does not mutate inputs.
